product.title: OLO Premium Markers - Brush
product.descriptionHtml:
Explore OLO’s premium alcohol-based brush markers and build your own color palette. The patented free-flow ink system delivers a smooth, controlled flow, while the flexible brush nib makes it easy to vary your stroke.

  • 2 ml of ink in each half marker
  • Flexible brush nib
  • Use an OLO Connector Ring to combine two half markers
  • Made in Japan

seo.title: OLO Premium Brush Markers | Shop Individual Colors
seo.description: Explore OLO premium alcohol-based brush markers. Choose individual colors, compare shades, and add your favorite colors to one order.
